name: Universal
source: CRON 20261014: Universal Insurance Plc consolidated statement of profit or loss for the year ended 30 June 2026, Group six months column 30-Jun-26 (NGX doclib filing library), thousands of naira scaled to naira. Insurance revenue less insurance service expenses equals the printed insurance service result from insurance contracts issued exactly, which is stored as Gross Profit; the printed net insurance and investment result plus other operating income less the printed other operating and administrative expenses equals the printed profit before tax, and less the printed income tax expense equals the printed profit for the year. EPS in naira per share from the printed kobo figure. | Universal Insurance Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (NAICOM publication approval NAICOM/TD/SUP/FA/RIC-019, 25 June 2026), consolidated statement of profit or loss, printed in NGN thousands and stored here in absolute NGN. EBIT = printed Net Insurance and Investment Result less printed Other Expenses; Net Finance Costs = printed insurance finance expense residual (Insurance Service Result + Net Investment Income less Net Insurance and Investment Result).
